name: dsh-px
description: DSH-PX: a native DeepSeek Harness plugin Pack and an official-source derived Windows Desktop.
author: Palbudir

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.format: prettier --write src packages scripts test config .github docs "*.json" "*.md"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src packages scripts test config .github docs "*.json" "*.md"
scripts.check:repo: npm run check:plugins && npm run check:docs && npm run check:secrets && npm run format:check
